name: On the Books
description: Your first find, weighed and entered. The Hollowdeep is now, officially, an income.

name: The Full Ledger
description: All twelve finds on the books. The ledger balances. It says nothing about you.

name: Unhurried
description: Finished without dying once. The cave had its chances, and you declined every one.

name: Nobody Asked
description: Finished without a single hint. Nobody asked. You didn't either.

name: The Answer
description: You found the gunnis, the older scar, and the answer to the question nobody asks aloud.

name: Everything You Carried
description: You visited the midden after the thief did, and it gave back everything you carried.

name: Kept the Seal
description: Eleven on the books, and the twelfth left where a wall was built around the keeping of it.

name: The Bird Went Too
description: You carried the canary all the way down to the vault. It saw what you saw.
